description: Content request system for Plex/Emby, connects to SickRage, CouchPotato, Sonarr, with a growing feature set.

promotion.reason: The pinned image was last rebuilt on 2021-07-09 and is a development build (development-v4.0.1446-ls143). Five years of unpatched base-image changes, and a build upstream does not call a release, is not something to hand somebody.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Asks people to request films and shows, and connects to media servers you configure. It creates an administrator account on first start.
